name: Bits of Love
source:
After getting a new job as a barista, you find yourself having to work amongst 4 handsome men! Will you fulfill your hopeless-romantic dreams and brew the perfect love story, perhaps at the cost of your livelihood? But beware, not every man will prove himself worthy of love.

[From [url=https://milkteacreatives.itch.io/bits-of-love]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
新入职成为咖啡师后，你发现自己竟要与4位帅哥共事！身为无可救药的浪漫主义者，你能否实现心中的美梦、亲手调制出一段完美的恋爱物语——哪怕代价可能是丢掉饭碗？不过可得当心了，并非每个男人都值得托付真心。

[摘自[url=https://milkteacreatives.itch.io/bits-of-love]Itch.io[/url]]
